import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    static final int MAXN = 10001;

    static class Edge {
        int v, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int v, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.v = v;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g = new ArrayList<>();
    static int nodeCnt;
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] pot = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] level = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

    static int addNodes(int cnt) {
        while (cnt-- > 0) {
            g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            nodeCnt++;
        }
        return nodeCnt - 1;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), cap, cost));
        g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, g.get(u).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
    }

    static boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0, nodeCnt, INF);
        Arrays.fill(used, 0, nodeCnt, false);

        PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
        dist[s] = 0;
        pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});

        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] curPair = pq.poll();
            int du = curPair[0];
            int u = curPair[1];

            if (used[u]) continue;
            if (du != dist[u]) continue;
            used[u] = true;

            for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                int v = e.v;
                if (e.cap == 0 || used[v]) continue;

                int nd = du + pot[u] + e.cost - pot[v];
                if (dist[v] > nd) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    pq.offer(new int[]{nd, v});
                }
            }
        }

        return used[t];
    }

    static boolean buildLevelGraph(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, 0, nodeCnt, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        level[s] = 1;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();

            for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                int v = e.v;
                if (e.cap == 0 || level[v] != 0) continue;

                if (dist[v] == dist[u] + e.cost - pot[v] + pot[u]) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }

        return level[t] != 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int f) {
        if (u == t) return f;

        int sent = 0;
        for (int i = cur[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); ++i) {
            Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
            int v = e.v;

            if (e.cap == 0 || level[v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + e.cost - pot[v] + pot[u]) continue;

            int ret = dfs(v, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
            if (ret > 0) {
                sent += ret;
                f -= ret;
                e.cap -= ret;
                g.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                if (f == 0) break;
            }
            cur[u] = i + 1; // update cur after processing edge
        }

        return sent;
    }

    static int[] minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxFlow) {
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0, nodeCnt, 0);

        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            int phaseFlow = 0;

            while (buildLevelGraph(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0, nodeCnt, 0);
                int df = dfs(s, t, maxFlow);
                maxFlow -= df;
                phaseFlow += df;
                if (maxFlow == 0) break;
            }

            flow += phaseFlow;
            cost += (dist[t] + pot[t]) * phaseFlow;

            for (int i = 0; i < nodeCnt; ++i) {
                if (dist[i] != INF) pot[i] += dist[i];
            }

            if (maxFlow == 0) break;
        }

        return new int[]{flow, cost};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        nodeCnt = 0;
        int L = Math.max(n, k) * 2;

        addNodes(L * n);
        int s = addNodes(1);
        int t = addNodes(1);

        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            int a = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            addEdge(s, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int z = 0; z < m; ++z) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;

            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < L; ++i) {
                int u1 = u + i * n;
                int v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n;
                int v2 = v + i * n;

                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    int w = c + d * (2 * j + 1);
                    addEdge(u1, v1, 1, w);
                    addEdge(v2, u2, 1, w);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < L; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                int u = j + i * n;
                int v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                addEdge(u, v, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < L; ++i) {
            addEdge(i * n, t, INF, 0);
        }

        int[] result = minCostFlow(s, t, INF);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
